enchantment.drill_mod.smelt.desc: Grants a 10% chance per level to autosmelt mined materials directly into the Drill's infinite inventory.
enchantment.drill_mod.range.desc: Increases the excavation size of the drill by x1.25 with each level (up to Level III).
enchantment.drill_mod.savedrill.desc: Automatically preserves and backs up the drill's inventory. If the drill breaks, you can restore all stored items into a new drill!
enchantment.drill_mod.indestructible.des: Makes the drill completely indestructible with an oscillating visual durability resonance.
